method: Read every proposal meaning, scope/type, discovery locator/support note, nearest baseline matches, and learning takeaway.
Independently inspected all cited baseline IDs and bounded label/alias/synonym searches. Meaning decisions are reviewer judgments, not acceptance of a literal miss or generated generic comparison.
Read captured public-source passages for higher-risk shared-name, subtype, and paraphrase cases; actual passage checks are identified per proposal.
Reviewed all 204 retained proposals; only 200 author-recommended rows are candidates for admission. Preserve three unresolved exclusions and one reserve.
limitations: This is a selection-identity review, not a full factual or relationship audit of cards that do not yet exist. Most routine discovery evidence was reviewed as author-supplied locator/support notes rather than reacquiring every passage.
Bounded baseline searches cannot prove absence of every possible synonym.
Cross-batch reservations/acceptance remain coordinator-owned; this report does not freeze IDs or authorize card drafting.
